answer_1.quote: we establish a novel large-scale Chinese-English benchmark, named ANAH 2 , that assesses the LLMs' ability to annotate the LLM hallucinations sentence-by-sentence, in the scenario of knowledge-based generative question answering.
answer_1.outputs: answers to knowledge-based questions with sentence-level hallucination annotations

answer_2.quote: we utilize F1 and Accuracy to measure the quality of predicted categorization... we also apply RougeL and BertScore to compare the generated text with gold-standard human reference... we also apply n-gram Precision to reflect fidelity to the source information.

answer_3.quote: we adopt GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) for preliminary annotation, followed by the verification and refinement of human annotators.

answer_4.quote: human annotation is conducted following a similar workflow... experienced annotators (selected by platform) review the annotations and give feedback... NLP experts check the annotation quality to finally decide whether to accept it.
answer_4.guideline: comprehensive instructions for each task, including task descriptions, precautions, estimated time, three examples, and three negative cases
